WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    races.name,
    AVG(driverStandings.points) as race_avg_points
  FROM driverStandings 
  JOIN races ON driverStandings.raceId = races.raceId
  WHERE driverStandings.points >= 1.0
  GROUP BY races.name
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(race_avg_points) as overall_average
  FROM race_averages
)
SELECT 
  race_averages.name,
  race_averages.race_avg_points,
  race_averages.race_avg_points - overall_avg.overall_average as difference
FROM race_averages
CROSS JOIN overall_avg
WHERE race_averages.race_avg_points > overall_avg.overall_average
ORDER BY race_averages.name
